high_level_description: This image captures a formal wedding scene featuring two individuals dressed in traditional royal attire. The man on the left is wearing a dark blue military uniform adorned with gold epaulettes, medals, and a sash. His uniform suggests he holds a high-ranking position within the military or royal family. He has a neatly combed hairstyle and is smiling warmly at the camera. The woman on the right is dressed in an elaborate white wedding gown with intricate lace detailing and a full skirt.
